title: DOW-UAP-D081, Narrative Statement 3, Western United States Event, 2023
doc_notes: This document is a memorandum for record from the AARO Director containing a first-hand narrative from a federal law enforcement agent regarding two UAP encounters in October 2023.

incidents.summary: Witness 3 observed a large orange orb that expelled three smaller red orbs while traveling in the western United States.
incidents.quote: I saw a large orange orb in the sky seemingly coming in my direction.

incidents.summary: Witness 3 observed four red lights hovering over an airfield and orange orbs near a ridgeline, followed by an interaction with a vehicle that floated off-road.
incidents.quote: These four red lights stopped above an airfield and hovered in what appeared to be a square over each corner of the airfield.
